name: Hargi Sundari
bio: Hargi Sundari is an Indonesian film actress.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. credits.overview: Putro returned to his village after being discouraged from pursuing his hopes and dreams in the city. Determined to start a new life and dreams of revitalizing his family's land through natural farming methods. credits.title: It's Official...
credits.overview: The youngest child, torn between family expectations and her existing relationship, faces an unexpected arranged marriage on the day of her father's death.

credits.title: Cinta Tak Pernah Tepat Waktu
credits.overview: Daku, a writer, feels pressed for time to find true love. In the midst of a complicated journey, he searches for the meaning of comfort in love.

credits.title: Jiwo
credits.overview: On his daughter’s wedding day, a father struggles with the onset of his mental illness and tries to compose himself to be the person his family needs him to be.

credits.title: From Sunset To Sunrise
credits.overview: A pair of ex-lovers who are both at the lowest point in their lives. The two of them suddenly meet while on a road trip from Yogyakarta to Bali. In each journey they realize that after the sun sets there will always be a sunrise. This has a very deep meaning for those who are at their lowest point to rise again.

credits.title: Pulang
credits.overview: Pras and Rindu, his daughter, traveled to Eyang's house, following Santi and Biru, his wife and youngest son. This trip will be their last journey as a complete family. Because secretly, Pras and Santi decided to divorce. Before reaching the destination, secret after secret was revealed one by one.

credits.title: Nyengkuyung
credits.overview: Nyengkuyung tells about the adventures of Pak Suratno, a former RT head who tries to hold a gamelan performance in the midst of his confusion about adapting to the new routine of becoming a retiree. In the midst of his efforts, he discovered odd things that were done by Pak Hari, the new RT head.
